page_title: HOF 0-4 BAY | Hoffenheim v Bayern Munich 17/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+2' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+2' Lovely run from Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
90' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Eric Dier trots off the pitch and is replaced by Gabriel Vidovic (Bayern Munich).
86' 0 - 4 Goal! A great through ball by Sacha Boey sets up Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the top right corner. 0:4.
82' Christian Ilzer has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim) replacing Anton Stach.
82' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Andrej Kramaric as he is replaced by Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim).
80' 0 - 3 Goal! Harry Kane pulls the ball back for Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) on the edge of the box, and he beats the keeper with a fine strike into the bottom right corner. 0:3.
80' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the left post. Unlucky!
77' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
76' A substitution has been made. Dennis Geiger is replaced by Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim).
74' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
67' Christian Ilzer prepares a substitution. Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) is replaced by Bazoumana Toure.
67' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) walks off the pitch to be replaced by Sacha Boey.
67' Substitution. Leon Goretzka has come on for Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich).
66' A dangerous towering header by Leo Ostigard (Hoffenheim) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
66' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) steps up to send the ball in.

66' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Manuel Neuer has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. The ball is out of play. Hoffenheim will have a chance to score from a corner.
63' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
61' That will be all from Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Harry Kane.
61' The substitution is prepared. Leroy Sane joins the action as a substitute, replacing Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich).
60' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) swings it in and Serge Gnabry gets on the end of it, but Oliver Baumann shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
58' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes.
53' 0 - 2 Goal! Michael Olise plays it to Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Oliver Baumann. 0:2.

51' Nice move, nice attempt! Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post.
47' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
46' Half-time substitution. Alexander Prass will not participate anymore and Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) is coming on.
46' Referee Daniel Schlager blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) receives a pass and unleashes a shot which goes well wide of the right post.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
44' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
40' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
36' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post.
33' 0 - 1 Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) can showcase his brilliant free kick ability, particularly from a distance like this. He hits the ball perfectly and it ends up inside the right post.
33' A dangerous free kick that is situated just outside the box will be taken by Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) who is well-known for his brilliant shooting technique.

33' Dennis Geiger (Hoffenheim) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Daniel Schlager blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Bayern Munich are awarded the free kick.
32' A pass from Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) is intercepted by Oliver Baumann and the move breaks down.
27' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
23' The linesman signals that Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
22' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar.
20' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the left post.
20' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

20' A cross from Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bayern Munich.
19' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

19' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The referee signals a corner kick to Bayern Munich.
14' Oliver Baumann comes off his line to intercept the corner from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich).
12' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
12' It looks like Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) saw red with that tackle. Daniel Schlager won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Bayern Munich have a free kick.
11' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
6' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) attempts to feed Serge Gnabry with a chip pass, but Oliver Baumann reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
4' Great teamplay by Bayern Munich as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Bayern Munich will have the kick-off.
Daniel Schlager was nominated as the referee for this game.
